# 0. Prepare environment and Load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# load data 
## SNPGWAS
SNPGWAS_RAxML <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_RAxML.txt")
## DBGWAS
DBGWAS_RAxML <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_RAxML.txt")
## PanGWAS
PanGWAS_RAxML <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.1.Main_analysis/PanGWAS_Panaroo_RAxML.txt")

# Add significance column, with bonferonni correction for multiple testing
SNPGWAS_RAxML <- SNPGWAS_RAxML |> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_RAxML), "significant", "not significant"))|> 
  mutate(significance = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant")))
DBGWAS_RAxML <- DBGWAS_RAxML  |> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_RAxML), "significant", "not significant"))|> 
  mutate(significance = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant")))
PanGWAS_RAxML <- PanGWAS_RAxML |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_RAxML), 1, 0))|> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_RAxML), "significant", "not significant"))|> 
  mutate(significance = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant")))
```


# 1. SNPGWAS
```{r}
# Manhattan plot
SNPGWAS_RAxML |>
  mutate(Position = as.numeric(str_split(variant, "_", simplify = T)[,2]))|>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Position, y= -log10(lrt.pvalue), color=significance))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / nrow(SNPGWAS_RAxML)), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size=1)+
  ylab("-log10(p-value)") + 
  xlab("Genomic Position") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "skyblue")) +
  theme_classic() 
```

# 2. DB-GWAS
```{r}
# Manhattan plot
DBGWAS_RAxML |>
  mutate(UnitigID = 1:nrow(DBGWAS_RAxML))|>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=UnitigID, y= -log10(lrt.pvalue), color=significance))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / nrow(DBGWAS_RAxML)), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size=1)+
  ylab("-log10(p-value)") + 
  xlab("Unitig ID") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "skyblue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

# 3. Pan-GWAS
```{r}
# Manhattan plot
PanGWAS_RAxML |>
  mutate(COG_ID = as.factor(1:nrow(PanGWAS_RAxML)))|>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=COG_ID, y= -log10(lrt.pvalue), color=significance))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / nrow(PanGWAS_RAxML)), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size=1)+
  ylab("-log10(p-value)") + 
  xlab("COG ID") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "skyblue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```
